pipette_mixing: A close-up video of a scientist repeatedly drawing up and dispensing liquid with a pipette inside the same small tube to mix it.
liquid_transfer: A close-up video of a scientist using a pipette to move liquid from one container into a different container.
pipette_positioning: A close-up video of a scientist positioning a pipette over a tube without drawing up or dispensing liquid.
